# `state/transaction/Transaction.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/transaction/Transaction.js`

state/transaction/Transaction.js — the one canonical transaction envelope.  Every authoritative state change flows through this envelope (spec §6). A transaction must STATE everything whose correctness depends on current state: read-set (expected versions), predicates, consumed inputs (USOs), created outputs, capabilities and external-effect intents. Checking only written objects is insufficient — predicate/write-skew anomalies require the read+predicate sets to be declared up front (spec rule 20).  The envelope is a plain, canonicalizable object; its transactionID is the secure hash of its canonical bytes (signature excluded), so the id is stable and tamper-evident.

## Functions

### `makeTransaction(spec = {})`

Build a canonical transaction envelope. Missing fields default to safe empty values so the shape is always complete (no partial transactions).

**Parameters:**

- `spec` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `spec.actorID` *(string)* — principal proposing the change
- `[spec.idempotencyKey]` *(string)* — `actor:task:operation` (deduplication)
- `[spec.causalParents]` *(string[])* — ids this tx causally depends on
- `[spec.predicateSet]` *(string[])* — named predicates that must hold
- `[spec.consumeSet]` *(string[])* — USO ids consumed (each at most once)
- `[spec.createSet]` *(string[])* — USO/version ids created
- `[spec.mergeOperations]` *(Array)* — CRDT merge ops (Phase 4)
- `[spec.capabilities]` *(string[])* — capability ids authorizing the change
- `[spec.externalEffectIntents]` *(Array)* — outbox intents (Phase 3)
- `[spec.policyVersion]` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[spec.validatorVersion]` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[spec.expiryEpoch]` *(number)* — proposal expiry (operational time)
- `[spec.deterministicSeed]` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** a frozen envelope WITHOUT id/signature (see sealTransaction)

### `transactionBody(env)`

Canonical bytes of an envelope EXCLUDING id + signature (the signed body).

### `sealTransactionFast(env)`

Attach a synchronous (fast) transactionID. Use for runtime/non-critical transactions where a 32-bit identity is enough.

**Returns:** frozen envelope with `transactionID`

### `async sealTransaction(env, signer = null)`

Attach a secure (SHA-256) transactionID and an optional signature produced by an authority signer. The signature covers the transactionID.

**Parameters:**

- `env` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** frozen sealed envelope
